screen size not visible in photos; needs label or measurement shot
model number not visible in photos; needs rear label or settings screenshot
resolution not shown in photos; needs settings info or box label

claims.claim: AI Smart TV with advanced features
claims.evidence: webOS and apps shown, but AI/advanced claims not visible in photos

risks.proof: photo of rear label or bezel showing inch size, or measuring tape beside TV
risks.if_unproven: priced as a smaller unknown-size TV
priced as an unspecified/base LG model
priced as HD or Full HD

risks.risk: TV has physical damage, cracks, or dead pixels
risks.proof: close-up photos or video of screen and bezel from multiple angles

risks.risk: TV does not power on or functions fail
risks.proof: video of TV powering on, navigating webOS, and testing inputs and sound
photo of remote control with the TV

risks.risk: Wall mount or stand not included
risks.proof: photo of brackets or stand, or clear inclusion in shot
risks.if_unproven: priced as TV only, no mount or stand

risks.risk: Soundbar and small black device not included or of unknown value

risks.if_unproven: priced without soundbar or black device

risks.risk: Age unknown and out of warranty
risks.proof: photo of purchase receipt, warranty card, or manufacture date label
risks.if_unproven: priced as out of warranty with unknown age

proof_requests: Photo of the TV rear label showing model number, screen size, and manufacture date
Video of the TV powering on, displaying webOS, and testing sound and inputs
Close-up photos of the screen for cracks, scratches, or dead pixels
Photo showing whether remote, stand/wall mount, soundbar, and black device are included
response.reason: The witness confirms an LG flat-screen TV, so it can be priced at worst case; missing specs and condition are unverified but do not prevent a baseline valuation.
